title.zh: Hackers Got Inside a Flock Camera. Its Data Shows How the System Works

current_state.zh: Hackers breached a Flock surveillance camera and its unencrypted on-device data, exposing how the license-plate-reading system works and highlighting serious security and vulnerability-disclosure failures.
